text.en:
Section three, subsection (b), of Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and sixty-tour is hereby
amended by striking out the word "Masaplud" and inserting in lieu thereof the word "Quinayan," of the
municipality of Guihulngan, Oriental Negros.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, February 3, 1914.
